resources.string: Keep wearing WHOOP, and your usual range will show up here.
Higher than your usual, in the Green zone. A good day for a quality session if you feel up to it.
In your usual range, in the Green zone. Your planned training fits if you feel up to it.
Lower than your usual, but still in the Green zone. Your planned training fits; no need to push past it.
Higher than your usual, still in the Yellow zone. A steady, moderate session fits.
In your usual range, in the Yellow zone. A balanced day of steady work fits.
Lower than your usual, in the Yellow zone. Easier movement fits today better than intensity.
Higher than your usual, still in the Red zone. Keep today light and protect tonight\'s sleep.
In your usual range, in the Red zone. Light movement and an early night fit today.
Lower than your usual, in the Red zone. Gentle movement fits today better than intensity.
Higher than your usual. Keep your sleep and training rhythm steady.
In your usual range. Consistent sleep and easy aerobic work help keep it here.
Lower than your usual. It often dips after short sleep, alcohol or hard training, so keep today easier and protect tonight\'s sleep.
Higher than your usual. Drink some water, keep training easy, and notice how you slept.
In your usual range. Regular easy aerobic work tends to lower it slowly, over months.
Lower than your usual. A steady routine helps keep it there.
You got more of the sleep you needed than usual. Keep the same rhythm tonight.
In your usual range. Consistent bed and wake times keep it steady.
You got less of the sleep you needed. A wind-down tonight can help you catch up.
More sleep debt than usual. An earlier lights-out tonight is a start.
In your usual range for sleep debt.
Less sleep debt than usual.
Higher than your usual. It can rise after hard effort, heat or a short night, so take it easy and notice how you feel.
In your usual range. It is one of your steadiest signals, so a change stands out.
Lower than your usual. It tends to stay steady, so the trend matters more than one night.
A bigger day than usual. Pair it with extra recovery tonight.
In your usual range for a day\'s load.
A lighter day than usual.
Compare this with your recent trend rather than any single reading.
